
==Cultural appropriation and sensitivity policies==
The Gaiad has had controversies associated with [[cultural appropriation]] involved with it and its development.

We will have a policy for correction of the Gaiad where people can request parts being edited to be more culturally sensitive, however we will also have a policy of not withdrawing or narrowing its scope or removing groups from it.

Our reasoning for this is simple: The Gaiad is a unique project distinct from earlier ones. We believe that by reducing the scope of the Gaiad or removing groups from it, the project of the Gaiad itself is threatened as it may cease to be able to function as a universal text anymore.

Additionally in the future it is quite possible groups which have requested exclusion may end up marginalized in the new social system. Members of such groups may be very upset at their exclusion. We do not believe it is ethical to risk this for future generations.
